name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Fire: the flame on the tail and the fire in the chest now flicker through three frames, in both views. Eyes: they glow brighter and dimmer on a slow cycle of about 3.6 seconds. Ribs (front): a real ribcage now, with a breastbone, ribs arching out and down from it to pointed ends, and an open arch underneath where the fire sits and the spine shows behind. Back: the spine now runs up through the neck into the head, and on down to the root of the tail. The wings leave from the shoulders on either side of it; before, the right wing's bone stood on top of the spine and read as part of it. The right wing now passes behind the head. The back also has four clear pairs of ribs and a solid hip bone, and the far arm is hidden.

note: Sixteenth look. Delta Charizard: flickering fire, slowly glowing eyes, a proper ribcage, and the back's spine running from the head.
